<observations>
Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User prefers black coffee before morning training; works a desk job with a standing workstation.
* 🔴 (08:30) User bought Nike Vaporfly 3 running shoes for race day (initial logs at 512 km).
* 🟡 (08:30) Garmin export: 28 activities, max run 14.2 km, resting HR 54, VO2 max 47, sleep 71, HRV 62 ms, weekly mileage 31 km; physio set 40 km weekly cap pending knee check.
* 🟡 (09:45) Agent calculated tapering for October half marathon and searched Seattle nutrition stores.
* 🟢 (11:05) User asked about electrolytes for runs under 10 km (agent explained sodium/potassium benefits).
* 🟢 (14:22) User asked about foam rolling calves/hamstrings (agent recommended hip flexor mobility).
* 🔴 (16:40) User is allergic to artificial strawberry flavoring in energy gels (reviewed maple alternatives).
* 🟢 (18:30) User asked about uphill stride cadence (agent suggested short, quick steps and upright torso).
* 🟢 (20:45) User planned to sleep by 22:00.

Date: Jul 27, 2026
* 🟢 (07:12) User asked about static vs. dynamic stretching before tempo runs (dynamic preferred).
* 🔴 (09:20) User prefers true crime podcasts for long runs (agent compiled 3 recommendations).
* 🟢 (11:30) User asked about humidity effects on sweat/exertion (agent calculated 4.5% pace efficiency drop).
* 🔴 (13:50) User prefers oatmeal with almond butter 2 hours pre-run.
* 🟢 (14:35) User asked how to clean salt stains from synthetic shirts (agent recommended cold water and white vinegar soak).
* 🔴 (16:10) User planned farmers market visit for blueberries; weekend high 28°C.
* 🟢 (18:50) User asked about lower leg soreness after hill repeats (agent suggested stationary bike instead of easy jog).
* 🟢 (20:15) User reads before 21:45 lights out.

Date: Jul 30, 2026
* 🟢 (07:15) User asked if pre-run bananas cause cramping (agent confirmed quick glycogen without GI distress).
* 🔴 (09:25) User bought HydratePro electrolyte powder from downtown boutique (agent verified sodium/potassium ratios).
* 🟢 (11:40) User asked how to calculate sweat loss via weighing (1 kg lost = 1 L fluid deficit).
* 🔴 (13:55) User prefers shaded tree canopy routes during midday heat.
* 🟢 (14:40) User asked about core exercises for posture (agent recommended 3 ten-minute transverse abdominis routines).
* 🔴 (16:15) User needs seamless toe-box running socks (agent found breathable synthetic options at outlet).
* 🟢 (18:55) User asked if hip flexor stretches relieve lower back tightness (agent suggested runner-focused lunges).
* 🟢 (20:20) User practices box breathing before sleep.

Date: Aug 2, 2026
* 🟢 (07:30) User asked about morning humidity (84%) impacting target paces.
* 🔴 (09:15) User registered for Oakridge Community Half Marathon in September (6 weeks out).
* 🟢 (11:10) User asked if walking water stations ruins momentum (controlled walking improves hydration efficiency).
* 🟢 (13:00) User noted Garmin Forerunner 965 is on firmware 21.19.
* 🔴 (13:10) User booked sports massage for Thursday at Metro Physical Therapy.
* 🟢 (14:25) User asked about pre-tempo foam rolling (agent recommended light dynamic stretching instead).
* 🔴 (16:30) User added chia seeds to morning oatmeal.
* 🟢 (18:40) User asked how to prevent chafing (suggested anti-friction glide stick).

Date: Aug 6, 2026
* 🟢 (07:15) User asked about fluid adjustments for high humidity (agent recommended 500 ml/hr electrolyte mix).
* 🔴 (09:20) User purchased a handheld water flask from Peak Athletic Gear.
* 🟢 (11:30) User asked if asphalt hill repeats are safer than concrete (asphalt offers better shock absorption).
* 🔴 (13:40) User completed sports massage at Metro Physical Therapy.
* 🟢 (14:50) User asked about gentle evening stretching for recovery (agent suggested hip/glute mobility flows).
* 🔴 (16:55) User bought a ceramic foam roller from local sporting goods shop.
* 🟢 (18:30) User asked how to clean running caps (hand wash with mild detergent in cold water).

Date: Aug 10, 2026
* 🟢 (07:15) User asked if a banana 40 mins pre-run is enough (agent suggested adding a few almonds).
* 🔴 (09:20) User registered for the Skyline Half Marathon in early September (added to training calendar).
* 🟢 (11:30) User asked if cadence naturally increases in the final kilometer (adrenaline causes a spike).
* 🔴 (13:40) User ordered running shoe replacement insoles from SoleCare Technologies.
* 🟢 (14:50) User asked if fabric softener reduces wicking efficiency (confirmed it coats synthetic fibers).
* 🔴 (16:55) User cleared work schedule for physical therapy knee evaluation.
* 🟡 (17:35) User stated they do not know their max heart rate.
* 🟡 (17:45) Agent sent clinical assessment appointment reminder.
* 🟢 (18:30) User asked about recommended rest days in taper week (agent outlined standard 2 complete rest days).
* 🔴 (20:00) User staged running shoes near the front door for an early start.
</observations>
